title: SSF - Most Full Checker
description: Sorts pairs of carts into most full and least full signal strength equivalent fill level
features: Can only handle carts in 86gt+ internals
Red output is most full output and that cart will be sent first.
downsides: Both carts being checked need to be checked at the same exact gt
notes: ROTATION NOTE: This can be rotated in all 4 cardinal directions, however it will only work consistently if the carts are dropped into the starting tail from above with no X or Z velocity
